_meta.description: Page ids the reachability check (tests/validate-nav-reachability.js) currently finds unreachable from any menu entry, each with why it is not a regression. Entries may only be REMOVED (a page becomes reachable, or is deleted) or have their reason corrected — never added without the id first appearing as a genuinely new, justified exception. A NEW orphan not listed here fails the gate. Seeded 2026-08-19 against a real `npm ci`-equivalent install (node_modules symlinked into the worktree from the main checkout) — 40 orphans measured, each individually verified against its config/calling component before being listed here (openspec/changes/nav-reachability-gate/tasks.md task 2).
